quote: A vehicle must not be driven to the left side of the highway at any time: When approaching within 100 feet or traversing any intersection or railroad grade crossing. Subsection 2 does not apply upon a one-way highway.

activation.condition: A vehicle approaches within 100 feet of or traverses a railroad grade crossing on a highway.

obligation.description: Vehicle must not be driven to the left side of the highway during the stated condition.

exceptions.source_clause: Subsection 2 does not apply upon a one-way highway.

timing.description: Join original body-side, crossing extent, highway direction and camera frames over approach and traversal.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Use original body corners and reviewed centerline without an invented legal lateral cutoff.
Require source-reviewed stationary rail carrier other than streetcar and actual highway crossing at grade.
